record: Historic England statutory listed building entry 1334982
facts: Grade I fortified two-court house on a slope. Great Hall lies between the courts. Long Gallery is on the upper courtyard’s garden side. Gatehouse, Peveril Tower, chapel turret, crenellations, lead roofing and projecting transomed bays are documented.

record: Historic England Haddon park and garden designation
facts: Manor on a bluff with terraces and separately listed stable block and approach. The lower yard is southwest of the upper yard.

record: J. Alfred Gotch, The Growth of the English House, Batsford 1909, p.48, fig. 24
facts: Plan of the lower and upper courts, credited in the index after E. G. Wyllie.
